verdict.rationale: Whether a hosting platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Netlify's own code (platform, CLI or SDK) available under an open license. The only open-source mention describes a third-party Svelte framework in the integrations directory, which does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
